summary: Tested the expanded moderator/admin panel (iteration 9): 4 new tabs (Dashboard, Reports, Suspensions, Edit History) + new backend endpoints GET /api/moderation/stats, GET /api/moderation/suspensions, enhanced GET /api/edits filters. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_moderation_panel.py with 12 tests covering stats shape+auth, suspensions list+include_expired, and all /api/edits filter params (entity_type, action, q, date_from/date_to, user_id) — 12/12 PASSED. Frontend: logged in as admin, verified /admin loads with Dashboard as default tab, screenshot shows 10 stat cards populated (Movies 14, TV Series 7, Actors 86, Collections 3, Users 26, Moderators 5, Open Reports 0, Active Suspensions 7, Edits 24h 2968, Trash 1465) plus Recent Edits panel (10 recent) and Active Suspensions panel (7 users). Reports tab + reports-status-filter render and switch to Closed OK. Suspensions tab shows 7 active rows; include-expired checkbox toggles but same count (no expired suspensions in DB — expected). Edit History: all filter fields present (search, entity-type, action, date-from, date-to) and Apply refreshes list. All 7 previously existing tabs (Movies, TV Series, Actors, Users, IP Overlap, Trash, Collections) click without errors. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_moderation_stats + list_suspensions correctly use ObjectId→id string mapping and avoid returning _id — good.

list_suspensions include_expired=true base filter {"suspended_until": {"$exists": True, "$ne": None}} is correct and covers both active and expired. is_active field is computed server-side — good for client rendering.

list_edits date filter uses ISO string comparison with $gte/$lte on created_at which is stored as ISO — consistent and works. Note: date_to as a bare YYYY-MM-DD will compare lexicographically to full ISO (e.g. '2026-01-15' < '2026-01-15T10:00:00') so edits ON that end date get excluded; consider auto-appending T23:59:59 if end-inclusive semantics are desired.
ModerationTabs.jsx: all 4 new sub-components correctly include data-testid attributes on interactive elements — maps 1:1 to the testing spec.
File size: ModerationTabs.jsx (~470 lines) is within acceptable limits; could be split into 4 files if it grows further.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 new tabs + 7 legacy tabs render, no errors

seed_data_creation: None — purely read-only tests against existing data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New admin panel tabs (dashboard/reports/suspensions/edits) and backend endpoints (/api/moderation/stats, /api/moderation/suspensions, /api/edits filters) are fully working. Regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_moderation_panel.py. Minor consideration: GET /api/edits date_to does lexicographic ISO compare, so YYYY-MM-DD end dates are exclusive of that day — document or auto-extend to end-of-day if main agent wants end-inclusive semantics.
